_: The jars on the GitHub releases, one row per Minecraft branch (CONTRIBUTING.md, Minecraft versions), newest first. The wiki's download tables (src/data/code/downloads.ts) and the store pages and README read this, and build every link from it: the tag is <build>-<neoforge>, the files VineAndBarrel-<build>-<neoforge>.jar and VineAndBarrel-<build>-<fabric>.jar. After a release is up, set its versions here. From each branch's gradle.properties: release_game_versions (minecraft), minecraft_version (build), mod_version (neoforge), fabric_mod_version (fabric), the lower end of neo_version_range, fabric_loader_version, fabric_api_version without its +suffix. without: the optional mods with no build for that version and loader (left out of the branch's release.yml). curseforge: the file ids of the same jars on CurseForge (curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vine-and-barrel/files/<id>), for pages on CurseForge itself.
